response: The horizontal semicircular canal ocular reflex is indeed influenced by otolith organs input. This influence affects the axis of the reflex, resulting in the plane of compensatory eye movements induced by the horizontal canal stimulation not always being parallel to the canal. In other words, the otolith organs' input plays a role in modifying the direction of the eye movements triggered by the horizontal semicircular canal, leading to a more complex and nuanced response.
